typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		SYSTEMCODE as string,
		CLIENT as string,
		SYSTEMPOSITIONGROUP as string,
		SYSTEMPOSITIONGROUPDESC as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSourcep021ispprod
OLEDBSourcep021ispprod derive(loadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> GetCurrentdate
GetCurrentdate derive({Copy of SYSTEMPOSITIONGROUPDESC} = SYSTEMPOSITIONGROUPDESC,
		{Copy of SYSTEMCODE} = SYSTEMCODE,
		{Copy of SYSTEMPOSITIONGROUP} = SYSTEMPOSITIONGROUP,
		{Copy of CLIENT} = CLIENT,
		{Copy of loadDate} = loadDate) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		SYSTEMPOSITIONGROUPDESC as string,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SYSTEMCODE as string,
		CLIENT as string,
		SYSTEMPOSITIONGROUP as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		SYSTEMPOSITIONGROUPDESC = {Copy of SYSTEMPOSITIONGROUPDESC},
		loadDate = {Copy of loadDate},
		SYSTEMCODE = {Copy of SYSTEMCODE},
		CLIENT = {Copy of CLIENT},
		SYSTEMPOSITIONGROUP = {Copy of SYSTEMPOSITIONGROUP}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
